assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the supplied MICHAEL 4x4 pixel sprite sheet. Redesign the whole character in EVERY cell to a balanced SEMI-REALISTIC, gently charming fantasy RPG sprite, noticeably more mature than this baby-like reference. Preserve the 4 columns x 4 rows animation layout, 16 poses, gold-blond hair, white-and-gold armor, cobalt cape, white feathered angel wings, halo and sword. Primary style change: 3.5-head-tall youthful adult proportions (head ~28% of standing body height excluding halo, longer torso, visibly longer articulated arms and legs). Smaller almond-shaped blue eyes, a subtle nose and jawline, calm confident friendly expression, no cheek blush, no tiny baby mouth, no round infant face. Hands and boots properly proportioned, believable fitted plate armor with layered shoulder plates, realistic feather shapes, restrained steel/gold highlights, hair in tidy textured locks rather than an enormous fluffy mass. Keep a touch of softness and charm, not grim or photographic. High-quality hand-authored pixel art, visible crisp small square pixel clusters and thin dark outlines, restrained shading, no soft painterly blur or gradients. Think elegant approachable young angel knight. IMPORTANT: substantially reduce head/eye size and elongate the body versus the reference; do not produce another super-deformed cute chibi. Composition: square transparent PNG with precisely equal 4x4 cells. Each sprite centered on its cell, all grounded soles aligned at 88% of cell height, all body/head sizes consistent across poses. Keep at least 8% CLEAR TRANSPARENT gutter on ALL four edges inside each cell, including sword and wings. Full weapons inside cells, never crossing into another cell. Right-facing side-scrolling three-quarter view, full body visible. Poses in reading order: row1 relaxed idle sword lowered; idle gentle wing motion; running left foot forward; running passing feet. Row2 running right foot forward; running passing feet other leg; jump rising knees tucked wings raised; jump falling feet extended wings spread. Row3 landing crouch; sword attack anticipation blade raised behind; sword attack forward cut to right; sword follow-through down right. Row4 cast preparation sword raised; cast release sword upright wings open; hurt recoil with eyes narrowed; defeated kneeling with head bowed. No extra effects or sword arcs, no floating particles, no shadows or floor, no text or grid lines. Genuine transparent background.
